Ph.D. Thesis

Title: Resource Orchestration in Software-Defined Edge Networks for IoT
Supervisor: Dr. Ayan Mondal, IIT Indore.
Description:  Investigated adaptive resource orchestration mechanisms for Software-Defined Edge Networks (SDENs)
supporting IoT and Industrial IoT applications in softwarized 5G/6G environments. Designed throughput-aware, delay-
aware, traffic-adaptive, and energy-efficient SDN-based orchestration frameworks to manage heterogeneous IoT traffic
under dynamic network conditions. Developed evolutionary game-theoretic and heuristic optimization models to improve
bandwidth utilization, reduce processing delay, and minimize energy consumption.  Implemented and evaluated the
proposed frameworks using Mininet, Open vSwitch, and the Ryu SDN controller in scalable edge-enabled IoT scenarios.
Simulation Tool: Mininet Network Emulator and Ryu SDN Controller

Master Thesis

Title: Optimized ECDSA algorithm for secure and efficient use in IoT network.
Supervisor: Dr. Namita Tiwari, MANIT Bhopal.
Description: Developed a lightweight ECDSA-based security mechanism for capability-constrained IoT networks, focusing
on secure authentication under computational constraints.
Simulation Tool: Cooja simulator supported by Contiki OS.

Projects

• Formal Methods for Modeling and Verification of Intrusion Detection System in Wireless Networks.
 (January 2020 - October 2021)

    Supervisor: Prof. Sukumar Nandi (IIT Guwahati), Dr. Chandan Karfa (IIT Guwahati), Prof. Santosh Biswas
    (IIT Bhilai)
    Description: Formally modeled the MQTT protocol using Discrete Event Systems to analyze spoofing, replay,
    man-in-the-middle, and denial-of-service attacks.

• MANIT Surveillance System (October 2017 - March 2019)

    Supervisor: Prof. Nilay Khare, MANIT Bhopal.
    Description: Developed a sustainable, cost-effective, and eco-friendly security system by integrating the existing
    safety infrastructure at MANIT with an IoT-based solution to monitor access, detect intrusions, and support
    prevention of property loss.
   Hardware Used: Raspberry Pi, PIR Sensor, Pi Camera, Night Vision Camera, RFID Reader and tag, Flame
    Sensor.
   Tool and Software Used: Etcher, Twilio, Blynk app.
